title: Can You Use an Existing Survey When Selling a Texas House?
description: Have an old survey for your Houston-area house? Learn what to gather, how T-47 and T-47.1 fit, and what to ask before paying for a replacement.

substantiveDifference: Dedicated existing-survey acceptance and document packet; T47/T47.1 knowledge versus drawing distinction and original fence-change decision example. Existing title guide covers ownership/lien problems; inherited guide merely lists surveys among documents; disclosure guide concerns condition reporting, not survey acceptance.
